checks.source: Zenodo record description and README: one participant from each of six cohorts

checks.what: cohorts (five disease cohorts plus healthy older adults)
sampling frequency of the lower-back sensor (Hz)
sample interval is 10 ms in every recording
every recording is between 1 and 3 hours

differences: The Zenodo description speaks of 2.5 hours of real-world data per participant; the six recordings last 1.19, 1.93, 2.08, 2.29, 2.54 and 2.63 hours (mean 2.11). The paper's validation statistics (gait sequences, initial contacts, cadence, stride length) are for the full 108-participant study, whose data are not in this record, so only the cohort and sampling checks apply.
